newsitem.title: USA: Avondale in shipbuilding deal with ARCO Marine.
newsitem.headline: Avondale in shipbuilding deal with ARCO Marine.

text.p: Avondale Industries Inc. said Monday it signed a $332 million contract with Arco Marine Inc. to build two crude oil tankers.
New Orleans-based Avondale, which builds military and commercial ships, said the contract also provides options for three additional ships.
Construction is scheduled to start in December. At peak staffing levels, the programme will employ about 2,200 people. Delivery of the first ship is scheduled for the first quarter of 2000.
Arco, based in Long Beach, Calif., expects to release design details July 29, Avondale said.
Avondale's stock rose 69 cents to $21 on Nasdaq.
